name: agent-batch-reviewer
description: Reviews multiple open pull requests of a project in parallel. The batch-reviewer skill fans out one Codex-backed pr-reviewer subagent per PR — each in its own isolated worktree — and every reviewer posts its own verdict as a PR review comment; the orchestrator aggregates a batch report. Engages only for multi-PR batches, deferring single-PR/diff review to /review and /code-review. Drives the agent-project-issues MCP and the Codex plugin.
